# Convert XML to readable text
import re
with open('tasks/t0078_bedb_mobo_v2_ais_tiered_ahp/assets/paper/10.1016_j.neuron.2012.08.041/files/rivlin-etzion_2012_directional-preference-reversal.xml', 'rb') as f:
    data = f.read().decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
# Strip XML tags but keep text
text = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', ' ', data)
text = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text).strip()
print(f'Length: {len(text)}')
print(text[:3000])
